en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abu Jameela who said, 
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘
Become such that you are hoping from there where there is no hope for you to what will (come your way),
for Musaas went to attain fire for his family, so heas returned to them and heas was a Mursil Prophetas’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from abu Jamilah who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying,
‘Your hope for help from an unexpected source should be greater than an expected source.
Musa ‘Alayhi al-Salam, went to find fire for his family and came back as a prophet commissioned to preach.’”
